Ndaigashira, yangu ndarasa, Ndinopfeka upenyu hwenyu        Ndadzorerwa nerufo rwangu, Ndaruramiswa nemwi Tenzi
Ndaereswa neinzwi renyu, Ndozogashira mbiri yenyu
Da’Dzira Hondo, mhandu yapetyo, Sim’dza mureza waTenzi
Pfeka chishangu, Simbayi mese, Simbirayi painzwi rake
Kristu m’tungamiri wehondo        Farayi mukumbane nemhandu, Idi rinokurirazve
Chishangu nemureza zvipenye, Tichakurira, hatitadzi        O Mwari wevese chitinzwayi, Tibatsireyi netsitsi
Mukuchinja kwenguva, Nditungamire Tenzi        Muribako’ro rangu, Cham’pupuri chauya
Handizotyi ndinemwi, Ndinosimbira imwi        Ndisvitse kumagumo, Cham’pupuri chapera
Kwava noumwe wakafa panzwimbo yangu, Kuti mweya sowang’ upone
Wabvuma kufamba m’nzira yemuchinjiko, Kuti asunungure ini
O zvizhinji sey’ atakura!, Nekurwadzwa kose;
Jesu atakura, zvese zvitema zvangu         Anemutsa, rudo, nenyasha kuneni, Anochenesa mwoyo wangu
Handichina kuraswa, ngasununguka, Zvaroverwa pam’chinjiko        Ndichabatirira kuna muponesi, Ndichafara ndiri murwendo
Ndine rwiyo momwoyo nepamuromo, Zvitema zvangu zvazobviswa
Apo ndati kuna Jesu, Zvese zvese ndezvangu
Apo ndati kuna Jesu, Hapana nechenyuba       Asi’ ye akandiwana, Ndakam’vona pamuti
Nemwoyo wangu ukati, Zvino zvimwe ndezvangu
Nemwoyo wangu ukati, Nezvimwe ndezvako         Misi yose mutsa wake, Unondibatsira, wondipfavisa
Ndichiti zvangu zvova zvishoma,  Zvako zvova zvizhinji
Zvako zvava zvizhinji        Rudo rwenyu rwakakwira, Nekudzama kupinda
Zvese zvazova zvenyu, Tenzi rudo rwakurira

Vaponeswa vachafara kuna Jesu ouya.        Imbayi vadyi venhaka, Farai muchienda
